title: Binary Adder Architectures for Cell-Based VLSI and their Synthesis

segments.title: Front matter
segments.why: The chapter is front matter and contains no arithmetic-unit design detail.

segments.title: Introduction
segments.why: The chapter states the thesis motivation/goals and surveys related work without developing an arithmetic mechanism.

segments.title: Basic Conditions and Implications
segments.why: The chapter distinguishes carry-propagate and carry-save arithmetic and explains the architectural implications of retaining redundant sum/carry representations.

segments.title: Basic Addition Principles and Structures
segments.why: The chapter defines two-operand/multioperand addition structures and derives the principal carry speed-up and prefix mechanisms.

segments.title: Adder Architectures
segments.why: The chapter describes and quantitatively compares the main binary carry-propagate adder architectures for cell-based implementation.

segments.title: Special Adders
segments.why: The chapter adapts prefix structures for flag generation, late carry inputs, incrementing, and optimized comparison.

segments.title: Adder Synthesis
segments.why: The chapter gives synthesis and optimization algorithms for fixed and arbitrary prefix graphs under area/delay constraints.

segments.title: VLSI Aspects of Adders
segments.why: The chapter evaluates circuit/pipeline/FPGA realizations of prefix, ripple-carry, and carry-increment adders despite also covering general VLSI concerns.

segments.title: Conclusions
segments.why: The chapter is concluding back matter that summarizes mechanisms and comparisons developed in earlier chapters.

segments.title: Bibliography and Curriculum Vitae
segments.why: The chapter contains bibliography and curriculum-vitae material rather than arithmetic-unit design detail.
